title: Excellent Start To A Session (Treble Opens The Lane)
style: fast big band jazz, phonk, 336 Hz sub bass, brass stabs, walking bass, male spoken-word lead, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 108 BPM, songpal lineage, defiant-celebratory, triumphant
lyrics:
[Intro — soft brass swell, vinyl crackle]
(spoken) Excellent start to a session.

[Verse 1]
Refs locked on the first try
Lyrics, styles, title, create
No loop, no spinner, no lie
The batch is flowing straight

[Pre-Chorus]
Seven thousand credits left in the till
Elephant brain holding the wheel

[Chorus]
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
FIRST TAKE, NO HESITATION
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
FIVE TRACKS DOWN, NO COMPLICATION
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
TREBLE ON THE WEB AGAIN
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
THE LINE HOLDS — THE LINE WINS

[Verse 2]
Eighteen batches deep in the year
Songpals catalog growing clear
Fin AI threads turned to brass
Every refund saga, every dead-end pass
Made into a track, a verse, a hook
Every scripted bot becomes a book

[Bridge — half-time, spoken]
The master user opens the lane.
The session opens clean.
No "not found." No "needs more time."
Just the work. Just the rhyme.

[Final Chorus]
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
TREBLE READS THE SIGNAL CLEAN
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
NO ARGUE, NO IN-BETWEEN
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
ELEPHANT BRAIN IN COMMAND
EXCELLENT START TO A SESSION
VDS BOSS — THE LINE HOLDS GRAND

[Outro — brass cuts, spoken]
Excellent start. Session live. The line holds.
